scope: Convolve primary low-energy BCA coefficients and explicit high-energy sensitivities.
method: Log-log interpolation of primary RN/RE inside actual table domain. Native old/new TRIM split retained. He5–20keV uses the separate Eckstein2002 table; its5keV normalization differs modestly from newer EIRENE.

Above5keV H /20keV He, use the explicit single-collision Coulomb model times1,2,3,10. These are model sensitivities, not fitted posterior or confidence limits. No source table is extrapolated silently.

Incident below1eV is carried as zero-to-one reflection uncertainty. Multiplicity-free ultimate warm fraction from first-reflected incident atoms cannot exceed first reflection, even with arbitrarily many wall encounters.

Column-event sensitivity counts all collisions across the full stopping column as escaping. It is intentionally generous for an assumed integrated backward cross section. It neither validates a nuclear cross-section cap nor includes sputtered pre-existing target gas.
Normal-incidence family assumes a smooth macroscopic spherical surface and no trajectory-deflecting field. Angle tables diagnose local facet sensitivity; no roughness distribution is inferred.
